notes: Release date 2026-04-16: newsroom index "Apr 16, 2026 - Introducing Claude Opus 4.7" (tier A); OpenRouter created 2026-04-16 matches same-day. First model released under the Project Glasswing graduated-safeguard approach: cyber capabilities deliberately differential-reduced during training; automatic safeguards block prohibited/high-risk cyber requests with fallback; Cyber Verification Program for legitimate defenders. claude-opus-4-7-fast has no newsroom entry - folded as a model here with OpenRouter listing date 2026-05-12 as the only trace. Table values are image-only (pending) with vision reads in notes; cross-vendor anchors all hit (GPT-5.4/5.5 columns equal OpenAI self-reports). Not turned into rows: Warp Terminal-Bench anecdote; Qodo TBench tasks; Databricks OfficeQA Pro 21% fewer errors (customer quote, relative); Rakuten-SWE-Bench 3x resolution (customer-internal); XBOW visual-acuity 98.5% vs 54.5% (customer-internal); token-effort curve chart (ff97ab0f image); misaligned-behavior chart (3a5b5c3e image) where Mythos Preview rates lowest; instruction-following literalism warning (re-tune prompts written for earlier models); task budgets beta; /ultrareview; auto mode; migration tokenizer notes; pricing unchanged from 4.6 at USD 5/25 per MTok.
